review_description: The quoting process didn't involve an on site inspection, so they set themselves up for failure by not understanding that I needed an AC coupled system as I already had a Fronius inverter with smart consumption meter and EV charger setup to use excess solar. This information didn't get passed to the installer for the day, so he needed to design the system on the fly, requiring tech support from the battery manufacturer and initially installed the backup circuits to bypass my Fronius smart meter, impeding the EV charger from using excess solar, so as part of my verification this was addressed on site. They did provide me with adequate information to operate the system and a signed CCEW. A more robust quoting and planning process would be beneficial.

Don't use them. We strongly warn all possible future customers about using DNR solar. We had difficulty with this company from the beginning from the installation of the solar panels to our meter box and then with our first energy bill being $2000! Don't get into the same problems with our now facing and fighting a constant battle for more support from this company with grid connection, install or any help at all. I wouldn't recommend them to anyone and they are particularly unpleasant to deal with!
The installation went without any hiccups, including the installation of the hardware. They even adjusted the installation to make sure it works, no matter how bad the weather is.

* Sales / quoting experience with Justin was very professional.. With his knowledge of solar & his Skill in explaining why & what system suited my situation at a realistic price, made choosing D.N.R.an easy choice ...*Planning & coordinating. A big thanks to Sam & Alicia for a job well done, no problems at all. That is a very big plus for D.N.R. They also helped me organised  the grid connection after the install..*Installation/ carried by Damien & his assistant. It was a pleasure to see tradesman doing a job in a very neat & tidy manner. Damien also took the time to explain to me how everything works. Nothing was a problem for him.
Good price informative quotes and somewhat local .hassle free install very flexible to other requirements such as removing old solar hot water panels.Would recommend.

I was looking for a reputable company on the Central Coast of NSW and couldn't be happier with the team from DNR.Professional from the get-go; with prompt call backs and follow up resulting in a competitive price for my Hyundai/Sungrow + Solar Analytics.A special shout-out to Brendan and his offsider who battled 38C (in the shade) heat, and still completed the install on the day.
My solar installation was faultless. Great team, good workers, no foul language and left no mess. Oh, and the solar works perfectly

They worked with me to get the best system I could afford but did skimp on the installation, using stainless steel fixings. It was an excellent conversation from start to finiish and the business stood by their word. An excellent business to deal with.
